meta.name: pdf
meta.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to do anything with PDF files. This includes reading or extracting text/tables from PDFs, combining or merging multiple PDFs into one, splitting PDFs apart, rotating pages, adding watermarks, creating new PDFs, filling PDF forms, encrypting/decrypting PDFs, extracting images, and OCR on scanned PDFs to make them searchable. If the user mentions a .pdf file or asks to produce one, use this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对 PDF 文件进行读取、合并、拆分、编辑、加密等操作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要处理 PDF 文件的各种操作
copy.tagline_en: Read, merge, split, edit, and encrypt PDF files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently need to perform various operations on PDF files

howto.what: 装上后，只要涉及 PDF，Claude 会调用这套技能提供的 Python 库和命令行工具，完成读取/提取文字与表格、合并拆分、旋转、加水印、新建 PDF、填写表单、加密解密、抽取图片等操作，也能对扫描件做 OCR。
howto.when: 用户提到 .pdf 文件、要求生成 PDF，或提出合并、拆分、加水印、OCR 等任意 PDF 处理需求时触发。

say.text: 把这几个 PDF 合并成一个文件。
say.note: 会调用 pypdf 合并页面后输出新 PDF。

say.text: 把这份 PDF 里的表格抽出来，导出成 Excel。
say.note: 会用 pdfplumber 抽取表格并生成 xlsx。

say.text: 给这几页扫描件做 OCR，让文字可搜索。
say.note: 会先把页面转成图片，再识别为文字。

howto.what_en: When a PDF is involved, Claude uses this skill's Python libraries and command-line tools to read/extract text and tables, merge/split/rotate pages, add watermarks, create PDFs, fill forms, handle encryption/decryption, extract images, and OCR scanned documents.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions a .pdf file, asks to produce a PDF, or requests any PDF-related operation such as merging, splitting, watermarking, or OCR.

say_en.text: Merge these PDFs into one file.
say_en.note: Uses pypdf to combine all pages.

say_en.text: Extract the tables from this PDF and export them to Excel.
say_en.note: Uses pdfplumber and writes an xlsx.

say_en.text: Run OCR on these scanned pages so the text is searchable.
say_en.note: Converts pages to images, then recognizes text.
